bundle.description: Build a standalone browser-compatible ESM bundle
bundle.command: deno bundle --platform browser --format esm --sourcemap=linked --minify --output dist/miski.mjs mod.ts

bench.description: Run public and internal ECS throughput benchmark suites

bench:user.description: Run consumer-facing ECS gameplay throughput benchmarks

bench:memory.description: Measure retained heap and ArrayBuffer memory budgets

bench:query-archetype.description: Run the query/archetype performance probes (timings and allocation, no budgets)

bench:gc.description: Measure GC allocation pressure and enforce zero-allocation budgets

bench:all.description: Run throughput, memory, and GC allocation benchmark checks
bench:all.command: deno task bench && deno task bench:memory && deno task bench:gc

prep.description: Format, lint, and check the codebase
prep.command: deno fmt && deno lint && deno task check

check.command: deno check mod.ts src/**/*.ts test/**/*.ts bench/**/*.ts example/**/*.ts && deno check --config example/visual/deno.json example/visual/client.js && deno check scripts/consumer-smoke.ts scripts/check-docs.ts

check:docs.description: Type-check the JSDoc examples in mod.ts (deno check --doc)

test.description: Run tests with the committed lockfile

publish:dry-run.description: Validate the JSR package without publishing

smoke:consumers.description: Verify clean npm and Bun installs, consumer types, and the browser bundle

ci.description: Run formatting, linting, type-checking, doc examples, tests, memory and GC budgets, and publish validation
ci.command: deno task fmt:check && deno lint && deno task check && deno task check:docs && deno task test && deno task bench:memory && deno task bench:gc && deno doc --lint mod.ts && deno task publish:dry-run
